description: This PHP test class file contains unit tests for the EmployeeLicenseDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations and license retrieval functions related to employee licenses in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeLicenseDao, testing employee license operations such as retrieval, deletion, search, save, and allowed licenses.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up the EmployeeLicenseDao instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employee license by employee and license ID.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified employee licenses.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests searching for employee licenses with filters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicenseWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests saving (creating or updating) an employee license record.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employee license.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of employee licenses matching certain criteria.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed licenses for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of allowed licenses for an employee.
